    Profile

    Mesarthim is a warrior of the Envy Layer who wields a silvery-white shield. She believes that the best defense is a good offense, treating even her shield as a weapon. She is tolerant of her allies, but her strong nature leads her to try to solve every problem with force. Because of her powerful body, she often underestimates her own strength.

    Origin: Envy Layer
    Gender: Female
    Height: 164cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Jan 19
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: A future of hope
    Hobbies: Talking on the battlefield
    Illust: だーくろ（G-ROW）
    CV: 逢田梨香子
